_about: F1/F4 dragon clip playback (2026-11-18). Generated by tools/dragon_refine/build_playback_data.py; edit the "moves", "fades", "turn" and "foot_lock" blocks by hand to tune without a rebuild. Rates multiply the clip's authored (source video) speed; 1.0 plays it as generated. Holds are source-frame spans the fit holds still; only they may run faster than 1.25. -VeyrLegacyClipTempo restores the old timing.
